summaries.text: Halt Electricity Price-gouging in San Diego Act, or HELP San Diego Act - Directs the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to issue an order establishing the maximum price for electricity sold at wholesale in the Western System Coordinating Council after June 1, 2000. Prescribes guidelines governing: (1) maximum electricity prices; (2) mandatory refunds of prices paid in excess of such maximum; and (3) civil penalties for violations of this Act.
